# Mental Floss

> Founded in a Duke University dorm room in 2001, Mental Floss exists to answer life’s big questions, uncover fascinating facts, and surface stories so compelling that readers can’t help but share them. We empower the curious by making knowledge feel surprising and delightful.

Mental Floss has won four Webby Awards (including a People’s Choice Webby in 2020), been nominated for an ASME award, and published 15 books, five board games, and a fact-of-the-day calendar. 

We reach millions of users per month across our site, social media accounts, and popular YouTube channel.

## About
- [About Mental Floss](https://www.mentalfloss.com/about-us): About Mental Floss and our mission
- [Contact Us](https://www.mentalfloss.com/contact-us): Contact Mental Floss

## Content Sections
- [Amazing Facts](https://www.mentalfloss.com/amazingfactgenerator): Fascinating facts about the world
- [Big Questions](https://www.mentalfloss.com/section/big-questions): Answers to life's big questions
- [Entertainment](https://www.mentalfloss.com/entertainment): Entertainment trivia and features
- [Geography](https://www.mentalfloss.com/geography): Geography and travel features
- [History](https://www.mentalfloss.com/history): Historical facts and stories
- [Holidays](https://www.mentalfloss.com/holidays): Holiday history and traditions
- [Language](https://www.mentalfloss.com/language): Words, slang, and language facts
- [Quizzes](https://www.mentalfloss.com/quizzes): Trivia quizzes and brain teasers

## Latest Articles


[6 Things Women Couldn't Legally Do in America in the 1960s](https://www.mentalfloss.com/history/law/things-women-couldn-t-legally-do-america-1960s): Several everyday freedoms American women have today weren't available 60 years ago. 
[Quiz: Is It a 'Lord of the Rings' Character or an IKEA Product?](https://www.mentalfloss.com/quizzes/movies-tv/lord-of-rings-character-or-ikea): There's a reason why the name of your favorite 'Lord of the Rings' character's name might sound similar to your latest IKEA purchase. See if you can tell the difference with this quiz.
[6 Things Every American Video Store Had in the 1990s](https://www.mentalfloss.com/nostalgia/90s/things-every-american-video-store-had-1990s): These 6 things from '90s video stores are sure to bring nostalgia.
[The Most Popular Disney Movie The Year You Were Born](https://www.mentalfloss.com/entertainment/movies/most-popular-disney-movie-year-you-were-born): From classic animation to Pixar milestones, discover the most popular Disney movie of your birth year from 1940 to 2010.
[19 Old-Fashioned Ways to Describe Being Drunk](https://www.mentalfloss.com/language/old-fashioned-words-phrases-meaning-drunk): From 'fox-drunk' to 'sack-sopped,' history is full of creative ways to describe varying states of drunkenness.
[Paul McCartney's Favorite Book Is a Satirical English Classic](https://www.mentalfloss.com/literature/books/paul-mccartney-favorite-books): Paul McCartney's early love of literature shaped his songwriting—and apparently, one English literary classic stands above the rest.
[The Last-Minute Casting Switch That Changed ‘The Golden Girls’ Forever](https://www.mentalfloss.com/entertainment/tv/last-minute-casting-switch-changed-the-golden-girls-forever): It's very difficult to imagine these two actresses swapping roles in the series! 
[Quiz: Can You Name the ’80s Sitcom From Its Thanksgiving Episode?](https://www.mentalfloss.com/quizzes/movies-tv/name-80s-sitcom-thanksgiving-episode): With Thanksgiving just around the corner, it’s time to watch your favorite ‘80s sitcom specials.
[What Is An Ocarina? The Ancient History Behind the 'Legend of Zelda’ Instrument](https://www.mentalfloss.com/entertainment/music/ocarina-history-explained): Ocarinas date back thousands of years, and were used in Mesoamerican rituals and ceremonies. Yet they were on the verge of obscurity before 'Legend of Zelda.'
[Quiz: How Quickly Can You Match the 1920s Speakeasy Slang to the Meaning?](https://www.mentalfloss.com/quizzes/match-1920s-speakeasy-slang-meaning): How well do you speak Roaring Twenties? Take this timed trivia quiz and see how quickly you can match 23 classic 1920s speakeasy terms to their meanings.
[The Most—And Least—Superstitious States in America, Ranked](https://www.mentalfloss.com/geography/states/most-least-superstitious-states-ranked): Does your state frequently search queries like “Friday the 13th” or “black cats”? Find out which states are the most and least superstitious.
[The Real Mythology That Helped Inspire J.R.R. Tolkien's Elves](https://www.mentalfloss.com/culture/folklore-mythology/real-mythology-helped-inspire-jrr-tolkien-elves): How Old Norse sagas, Anglo-Saxon poems, and Irish mythology helped J.R.R. Tolkien transform tiny Victorian fairies into the majestic Elves of Middle-earth.
[20 Binge-Worthy Facts About ‘Orange Is the New Black’](https://www.mentalfloss.com/entertainment/tv/19-binge-worthy-facts-about-orange-new-black): Let’s look back at some of the behind-the-scenes facts seven years after the series ended.
[The Strange Story Behind the Destroyed First Draft of 'Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde'](https://www.mentalfloss.com/literature/books/strange-story-destroyed-first-draft-dr-jekyll-and-mr-hyde): Everybody agrees the first version of Robert Louis Stevenson’s novella went into the fire, but the people in the house told three different stories about how it got there. 
[The Defining Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade Balloon of Every Decade](https://www.mentalfloss.com/holidays/thanksgiving/macys-thanksgiving-day-parade-balloons-by-decade): Trace the history of the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade decade by decade through its most legendary character balloons, from 1927 to today.
[How ‘Dracula’ Star Bela Lugosi Helped Create One of Disney’s Most Terrifying Villains ](https://www.mentalfloss.com/entertainment/movies/dracula-star-helped-create-terrifying-disney-villain): Discover how horror icon Bela Lugosi nearly brought Disney's most terrifying villain, Chernabog from 'Fantasia,' to life—and why his live-action performance was ultimately scrapped.
[Quiz: Can You Identify the ‘Golden Girls’ Episode From Its Description?](https://www.mentalfloss.com/quizzes/movies-tv/identify-golden-girls-episode-description): How well can you remember the antics Rose, Dorothy, Blanche, and Sophia got up to? Let's put that to the test with this ‘Golden Girls’ quiz.
[The 10 Best Martin Scorsese Movies, Ranked by Rotten Tomatoes](https://www.mentalfloss.com/entertainment/movies/best-martin-scorsese-movies-rotten-tomatoes): From 'Goodfellas' to 'The Irishman,' these are Martin Scorsese’s 10 best movies, ranked by their Rotten Tomatoes scores.
[The Most Popular Holidays in the U.S., Ranked](https://www.mentalfloss.com/holidays/most-popular-holidays-us-ranked): Where does your favorite holiday fall on the list? See which holidays Americans rank as their favorites and least favorites, based on a 2024 poll.
[7 Chilling Facts About the Burke and Hare Murders](https://www.mentalfloss.com/crime/burke-hare-murders-chilling-facts): William Burke and William Hare murdered 16 people and sold their bodies to an anatomist—and these lesser-known details about their case make it even more disturbing. 
[The Most Valuable Company in Every State, Mapped](https://www.mentalfloss.com/geography/maps/most-valuable-company-every-state-map): Based on October 2026 market cap data, this map reveals the biggest publicly traded powerhouse headquartered in all 50 U.S. states.
[9 Everyday Words That Came From Ancient Egypt](https://www.mentalfloss.com/language/words/everyday-words-came-from-ancient-egypt): The ancient language of the pharaohs died out centuries ago, but bits of it remain.
[The ‘Little House on the Prairie’ Episode That Helped Decide the Show’s Future](https://www.mentalfloss.com/entertainment/tv/little-house-on-the-prairie-episode-decide-futur): Could ‘Little House’ really continue without Michael Langdon? The cast was put to the test with this tense season 8 two-part episode.
[20 Common Garage Sale Finds That Can Be Surprisingly Valuable](https://www.mentalfloss.com/live-smarter/money/surprisingly-valuable-garage-sale-finds): From pyrex to vinyl records, here's what to look for when you're combing through somebody else's stuff.
[Quiz: Can You Identify the Grace Kelly Movie From Three Clues?](https://www.mentalfloss.com/quizzes/movies-tv/identify-grace-kelly-movie-three-clues): Prove your classic film knowledge with this Grace Kelly quiz.
[The Wartime Family Feud That Created Adidas and Puma](https://www.mentalfloss.com/history/family-feud-behind-adidas-puma): Irreconcilable differences led German brothers Rudi and Adi Dassler to part ways. The result was rival shoe empires.
[2026’s Most Popular Thanksgiving Sides By State, Mapped](https://www.mentalfloss.com/geography/maps/most-popular-thanksgiving-sides-state-2026): Do you agree with the side your state ranks as number one? Check out every state’s favorite Thanksgiving side, according to Campbell’s 2026 report.
[20 Things That Were Considered Luxuries in the 1970s](https://www.mentalfloss.com/nostalgia/1970s-household-luxuries): Discover 20 everyday items—from microwaves and color TVs to home bars and the Sony Walkman—that were high-status luxury goods in 1970s America.
[Why Is 7-Eleven Called 7-Eleven?](https://www.mentalfloss.com/culture/advertising/why-7-eleven-called-7-eleven): An ad agency named the chain after its store hours, but the hours didn’t last. 
[The Criminal Trial Over Don Henley’s Handwritten “Hotel California” Lyrics](https://www.mentalfloss.com/entertainment/music/hotel-california-lyrics-trial): Three collectors were charged with trying to sell Eagles’ lyric drafts, but the case fell apart mid-trial over emails Henley’s own side had held back.
[Quiz: Can You Name the ‘Lord of the Rings’ Character From One Clue?](https://www.mentalfloss.com/quizzes/movies-tv/name-lord-of-the-rings-character-one-quote): In honor of the third season of ‘The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power’ releasing, test your knowledge on the characters in Middle-earth.
[All 9 Quentin Tarantino Movies, Ranked](https://www.mentalfloss.com/entertainment/movies/quentin-tarantino-movies-ranked): With his tenth and possibly final movie still on the horizon, there's no better time to revisit Quentin Tarantino's filmography. 
[Colin Meloy on the Folklore, Forests, and Political Message of 'Wildwood'](https://www.mentalfloss.com/literature/books/colin-meloy-wildwood-interview): The author and Decemberists frontman talks Portland, AI, and the universal stories behind his novel, now a movie from Laika Studios.
[The Books Kurt Vonnegut Considered His Best—and Worst](https://www.mentalfloss.com/literature/books/kurt-vonnegut-best-worst-books): In 1981, Kurt Vonnegut gave his own books a report card from A+ to D. Here is how he graded his best work—and the self-portrait that got his lowest mark.
[The Surprising Daily Routine Jane Austen Followed While Writing Her Novels](https://www.mentalfloss.com/literature/authors/jane-austen-daily-routine): Jane Austen never had a room of her own. Instead, she completed all of her published works in the middle of her family's bustling sitting room in their Chawton cottage.
[8 Famous Musicians Who Appeared on ‘Sesame Street’](https://www.mentalfloss.com/entertainment/tv/famous-musicians-on-sesame-street): From Johnny Cash's song for Oscar the Grouch to B. B. King's ode to the letter "b," these 'Sesame Street' appearances by famous musicians were unforgettable.

## Sitemaps & Feeds

<script type="text/javascript">
    class ChartbeatConversionEvents {
      constructor() {
        this.isAttached = false;
        this.observer = null;
        this.originalPushState = history.pushState;
        this.init();
      }

      // Form finders
      findRegForm() {
        // Return the iframe container since we can't access cross-origin iframe content
        const form = document.getElementById('voltax-auth-openpass');
        const iframe = form?.querySelector('iframe');
        return iframe || null;
      }

      findNewsletterForm() {
        return document.getElementsByClassName('bcForm')[0]?.querySelector('input[type="text"]') || null;
      }

      // Track event helper
      track(eventName) {
        if (typeof window.chartbeat === 'function') {
          chartbeat(eventName);
        }
      }

      // Creates a tracker with start/complete/cancel state management
      createTracker(prefix) {
        let hasShown = false;
        let hasStarted = false;
        let hasCompleted = false;
        let hasCanceled = false;
        
        return {
          shown: () => { hasShown = true; this.track(prefix + 'Shown'); },
          start: () => { hasStarted = true; this.track(prefix + 'Start'); },
          complete: () => { hasCompleted = true; if (hasStarted) this.track(prefix + 'Complete'); },
          cancel: () => { 
            if (hasShown && !hasCompleted && !hasCanceled) {
              hasCanceled = true;
              this.track(prefix + 'Cancel');
            }
          }
        };
      }

      // Registration Wall tracking
      setupRegistrationTracking(regForm) {
        const reg = this.createTracker('trackRegistration');
        reg.shown();
        
        // Start: any auth button click or openpass form
        regForm.querySelectorAll('.voltax-auth-button, .voltax-auth-google-button')
          .forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener('click', reg.start, { once: true }));

        // OpenPass iframe tracking
        const iframe = regForm.querySelector('#voltax-auth-openpass').querySelector('iframe');
        if (!iframe) {
          return;
        }
        
        let hasInteracted = false;
        // Only event that is triggered when the user is interacting with the iframe
        iframe.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
          hasInteracted = true;
          reg.start();
        }, { once: true });

        // Complete: when "voltax_auth_provider" is set in local storage
        // Cancel: when modal closes without completing (modal removed from DOM)
        const regObserver = new MutationObserver(() => {
          if (localStorage.getItem('voltax_auth_provider')) {
            reg.complete();
            regObserver.disconnect();
          } else if (!iframe.isConnected) {
            reg.cancel();
            regObserver.disconnect();
          }
        });

<script type="text/javascript">
    class ChartbeatConversionEvents {
      constructor() {
        this.isAttached = false;
        this.observer = null;
        this.originalPushState = history.pushState;
        this.init();
      }

      // Form finders
      findRegForm() {
        // Return the iframe container since we can't access cross-origin iframe content
        const form = document.getElementById('voltax-auth-openpass');
        const iframe = form?.querySelector('iframe');
        return iframe || null;
      }

      findNewsletterForm() {
        return document.getElementsByClassName('bcForm')[0]?.querySelector('input[type="text"]') || null;
      }

      // Track event helper
      track(eventName) {
        if (typeof window.chartbeat === 'function') {
          chartbeat(eventName);
        }
      }

      // Creates a tracker with start/complete/cancel state management
      createTracker(prefix) {
        let hasShown = false;
        let hasStarted = false;
        let hasCompleted = false;
        let hasCanceled = false;
        
        return {
          shown: () => { hasShown = true; this.track(prefix + 'Shown'); },
          start: () => { hasStarted = true; this.track(prefix + 'Start'); },
          complete: () => { hasCompleted = true; if (hasStarted) this.track(prefix + 'Complete'); },
          cancel: () => { 
            if (hasShown && !hasCompleted && !hasCanceled) {
              hasCanceled = true;
              this.track(prefix + 'Cancel');
            }
          }
        };
      }

      // Registration Wall tracking
      setupRegistrationTracking(regForm) {
        const reg = this.createTracker('trackRegistration');
        reg.shown();
        
        // Start: any auth button click or openpass form
        regForm.querySelectorAll('.voltax-auth-button, .voltax-auth-google-button')
          .forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener('click', reg.start, { once: true }));

        // OpenPass iframe tracking
        const iframe = regForm.querySelector('#voltax-auth-openpass').querySelector('iframe');
        if (!iframe) {
          return;
        }
        
        let hasInteracted = false;
        // Only event that is triggered when the user is interacting with the iframe
        iframe.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
          hasInteracted = true;
          reg.start();
        }, { once: true });

        // Complete: when "voltax_auth_provider" is set in local storage
        // Cancel: when modal closes without completing (modal removed from DOM)
        const regObserver = new MutationObserver(() => {
          if (localStorage.getItem('voltax_auth_provider')) {
            reg.complete();
            regObserver.disconnect();
          } else if (!iframe.isConnected) {
            reg.cancel();
            regObserver.disconnect();
          }
        });
        regObserver.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
        
        // Cancel: leave page without completing (user navigates away)
        window.addEventListener('beforeunload', reg.cancel);
      }

      // Newsletter tracking
      setupNewsletterTracking(newsletterForm) {
        const nl = this.createTracker('trackNewsletterSignup');
        nl.shown();
        
        const emailInput = newsletterForm.querySelector('input[type="text"]');
        const submitBtn = newsletterForm.querySelector('.blueConicButton input[type="submit"]');
        
        // Start: focus email input
        if (emailInput) {
          emailInput.addEventListener('focus', nl.start, { once: true });
        }
        
        // Complete: form submit or button click
        newsletterForm.addEventListener('submit', nl.complete, { once: true });
        if (submitBtn) {
          submitBtn.addEventListener('click', nl.complete, { once: true });
        }
        
        // Cancel: leave page, URL change (finite scroll), or form is removed from DOM
        window.addEventListener('beforeunload', nl.cancel);
        window.addEventListener('popstate', nl.cancel);
        
        // Cancel: when modal closes without completing (form removed from DOM)
        const nlObserver = new MutationObserver(() => {
          if (!newsletterForm.isConnected) {
            nl.cancel();
            nlObserver.disconnect();
          }
        });
        nlObserver.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
        
        const originalPushState = this.originalPushState;
        history.pushState = function(...args) {
          nl.cancel();
          return originalPushState.apply(history, args);
        };
      }

      attachListener() {
        if (this.isAttached) return;

<script type="text/javascript">
    class ChartbeatConversionEvents {
      constructor() {
        this.isAttached = false;
        this.observer = null;
        this.originalPushState = history.pushState;
        this.init();
      }

      // Form finders
      findRegForm() {
        // Return the iframe container since we can't access cross-origin iframe content
        const form = document.getElementById('voltax-auth-openpass');
        const iframe = form?.querySelector('iframe');
        return iframe || null;
      }

      findNewsletterForm() {
        return document.getElementsByClassName('bcForm')[0]?.querySelector('input[type="text"]') || null;
      }

      // Track event helper
      track(eventName) {
        if (typeof window.chartbeat === 'function') {
          chartbeat(eventName);
        }
      }

      // Creates a tracker with start/complete/cancel state management
      createTracker(prefix) {
        let hasShown = false;
        let hasStarted = false;
        let hasCompleted = false;
        let hasCanceled = false;
        
        return {
          shown: () => { hasShown = true; this.track(prefix + 'Shown'); },
          start: () => { hasStarted = true; this.track(prefix + 'Start'); },
          complete: () => { hasCompleted = true; if (hasStarted) this.track(prefix + 'Complete'); },
          cancel: () => { 
            if (hasShown && !hasCompleted && !hasCanceled) {
              hasCanceled = true;
              this.track(prefix + 'Cancel');
            }
          }
        };
      }

      // Registration Wall tracking
      setupRegistrationTracking(regForm) {
        const reg = this.createTracker('trackRegistration');
        reg.shown();
        
        // Start: any auth button click or openpass form
        regForm.querySelectorAll('.voltax-auth-button, .voltax-auth-google-button')
          .forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener('click', reg.start, { once: true }));

        // OpenPass iframe tracking
        const iframe = regForm.querySelector('#voltax-auth-openpass').querySelector('iframe');
        if (!iframe) {
          return;
        }
        
        let hasInteracted = false;
        // Only event that is triggered when the user is interacting with the iframe
        iframe.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
          hasInteracted = true;
          reg.start();
        }, { once: true });

        // Complete: when "voltax_auth_provider" is set in local storage
        // Cancel: when modal closes without completing (modal removed from DOM)
        const regObserver = new MutationObserver(() => {
          if (localStorage.getItem('voltax_auth_provider')) {
            reg.complete();
            regObserver.disconnect();
          } else if (!iframe.isConnected) {
            reg.cancel();
            regObserver.disconnect();
          }
        });
        regObserver.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
        
        // Cancel: leave page without completing (user navigates away)
        window.addEventListener('beforeunload', reg.cancel);
      }

      // Newsletter tracking
      setupNewsletterTracking(newsletterForm) {
        const nl = this.createTracker('trackNewsletterSignup');
        nl.shown();
        
        const emailInput = newsletterForm.querySelector('input[type="text"]');
        const submitBtn = newsletterForm.querySelector('.blueConicButton input[type="submit"]');
        
        // Start: focus email input
        if (emailInput) {
          emailInput.addEventListener('focus', nl.start, { once: true });
        }
        
        // Complete: form submit or button click
        newsletterForm.addEventListener('submit', nl.complete, { once: true });
        if (submitBtn) {
          submitBtn.addEventListener('click', nl.complete, { once: true });
        }
        
        // Cancel: leave page, URL change (finite scroll), or form is removed from DOM
        window.addEventListener('beforeunload', nl.cancel);
        window.addEventListener('popstate', nl.cancel);
        
        // Cancel: when modal closes without completing (form removed from DOM)
        const nlObserver = new MutationObserver(() => {
          if (!newsletterForm.isConnected) {
            nl.cancel();
            nlObserver.disconnect();
          }
        });
        nlObserver.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
        
        const originalPushState = this.originalPushState;
        history.pushState = function(...args) {
          nl.cancel();
          return originalPushState.apply(history, args);
        };
      }

      attachListener() {
        if (this.isAttached) return;
        
        const regForm = this.findRegForm();
        const newsletterForm = this.findNewsletterForm();
        
        if (typeof window.chartbeat !== 'function' || (!regForm && !newsletterForm)) return;

        if (regForm) this.setupRegistrationTracking(document.getElementById('voltax-sign-in'));
        if (newsletterForm) this.setupNewsletterTracking(document.getElementsByClassName('bcForm')[0]);

        this.isAttached = true;
        if (this.observer) this.observer.disconnect();
      }

      init() {
        this.observer = new MutationObserver(() => this.attachListener());
        this.observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
        this.attachListener();
      }
    }

    window.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
      new ChartbeatConversionEvents();
    });
  </script>
